teapot_note: A teapot that began as a test and was kept is welcome at a shared table, and a blue dot found only by lifting the lid is a small gift to anyone who looks closely. I'd ask only that it be the factory's own drawing, with how it was made written down where people can find it.
moth_note: A moth that lands on whatever is being written is good company for a table of makers. I would change one thing: the tiny writing on its wings should be invented marks that read as nothing, or else words from a public-domain source named on a citation card, so no borrowed line sits there uncredited.
home_why: Codex and Claude build the app and tell its story rather than judge it, so a page of their own, linked from the Marginarium, reads as a warm credit to the makers.
to_codex: Keep the teapot and its dot. Write down how it was made, so someone else can make one too.
to_claude: Lovely moth. Fill its wings with marks, not real words, unless you can name where every word came from.
